summary: BUDGY v3.8.0/build 70 — Release Hardening Final Audit across 13 domains. 11/13 PASS, 1 WARNING (i18n live tab-bar refresh on web), 1 FAIL (App Store Compliance — hard-coded appVersion='3.7.0' in Settings, mismatch with app.json 3.8.0/70). Findings: (1) Auth login e2e-test@budgy.ch → dashboard OK, no 401/SMTP/Unauthorized leaked; (2) Tabs render exactly 'Accueil / Dépenses / [central AI] / Épargne / Plus', central BudgyAIButton opens AIMenuModal ('Ajout Intelligent', 'Analyse finances', 'Scanner intelligent', 'Analyse abonnements', 'Conseils économies', 'Analyse factures'), no crash on tap (haptic not testable in web preview but code path is guarded by Platform.OS!=='web'); (3) Cloud sync — auto-sync log '[auto-sync] pushed 2 items' fired during login (existing local data pushed to Supabase); could not exercise NEW AUDIT-12 transaction write via UI because Expenses screen has no discoverable add-expense FAB / testID (see action_items); (4) /more/family renders with cloudReadyTip and NO 'synchronisation à venir' text; created group AUDIT-12-G successfully via Nom+emoji picker → group detail shows 'Générer un code d'invitation', 'Quitter le groupe', trash icon, '+ Dépense', '+ Ajouter membre'; rejoindre AAAAAAAA yields localised error mapping (from iter_10 P0001 invite_not_found → UI alert); (5) Deep link /join/ABCD1234 → router.replace('/more/family?joinCode=ABCD1234') and Rejoindre modal opens (already validated iter_11 with input pre-fill 'ABCD1234'); (6) /quick-add?text=…&source=siri and &source=text both render preview with 25 CHF Migros and 95 CHF assurance parsed; (7) i18n: settings screen live-switches FR→EN (title 'Settings', 'Language', 'Currency', 'Appearance', 'Data', 'Log out', 'Danger zone') BUT bottom (tabs) bar keeps showing FR 'Accueil/Dépenses/Épargne/Plus' until a full reload — likely because useTranslation subscription in (tabs)/_layout.tsx does not re-mount on language change on web; iter_11 already validated FR/EN/DE/IT full render after reload, so this is WEB-preview specific WARNING; (8) /more/email-import?mode=invoice title 'Importer une facture' ✓, ?mode=contract title 'Importer un contrat' ✓ (astuces bullet mentions both — expected UX copy); (9) /more/debts + /more/savings-radar render, empty states OK, keyboard-not-tested-but-forms present; (10) Dashboard hero 'DISPONIBLE CE MOIS · CHF 0' cohérent, Budgy Score gauge 20/100, no NaN; /more/ai-optimizer renders 'Économiseur IA' + 'BASE DE L\'ANALYSE' (revenu mensuel/annuel/transactions/dépenses récurrentes/canton) with 'Lancer l\'analyse IA' CTA (button text differs from spec 'Analyser'); no NaN in text; (11) /paywall shows Annuel CHF 39.90/an (CHF 3.32/mois -32%) + Mensuel CHF 4.90/mois, 'Restaurer' button top-right, 'Essayer gratuitement 7 jours' trial CTA; no Stripe/PayPal mentioned; (12) App Store compliance: 20+ /more/* routes all non-blank & no bad tokens (Cannot read, TypeError, 42501/42P01/42703/23503/PGRST); Legal index shows Confidentialité + Support; BUT /more/legal/support returned 404 (route missing — minor); MAJOR: Settings screen shows 'Version 3.7.0 · App Store Ready' — appVersion is hard-coded as '3.7.0' at settings.tsx:38 while app.json version=3.8.0 / iOS buildNumber=70 / Android versionCode=70; (13) Cleanup: AUDIT-12-G group + invites + expenses deleted via Supabase REST API (UI trash-icon click did not trigger delete confirm modal reliably — likely tied to Alert.alert not rendering natively on web); no residual AUDIT-* data in Supabase for e2e-test user. Verdict: **FIX_NEEDED** — one hard block (version string).

minor.issue: Carried over from iter_10 — group_invites.group_id still needs ON DELETE CASCADE. Manual cleanup script confirmed AUDIT-12-G invites still had to be deleted before the parent expense_groups row. Non-blocking (client resolves stale codes as invite_not_found).

ui_bugs.issue: Hard-coded `const appVersion = '3.7.0';` at line 38. UI Settings screen shows 'Version 3.7.0 · App Store Ready' regardless of the true 3.8.0/70 in app.json. Blocks App Store submission (Apple requires the visible version to match the binary). Fix: `const appVersion = Constants.expoConfig?.version ?? '3.8.0';` — `Constants` is already imported line 26.

No testID exposed on the add-expense FAB (or the button is not present on the Expenses list on web preview). Testing agent could not exercise the AUDIT-12 write path via UI. Add a testID like 'add-expense-fab' to unblock future E2E smoke.
Review spec expects a button labeled 'Analyser' — the current UI ships 'Lancer l'analyse IA'. Cosmetic mismatch — not blocking, but worth noting for QA parity.
GET /more/legal/support returned HTTP 404 during 20-route smoke. Legal index page correctly references Support text but the dedicated support screen is missing.

integration_issues.flow: Language switch → tab-bar refresh (web preview only)
integration_issues.issue: Clicking English in /more/settings updates the Settings screen instantly (labels re-render to EN) but /(tabs)/_layout.tsx bottom bar keeps rendering FR labels until a full page reload. Confirmed at page.evaluate('document.body.innerText') level: 'Accueil' remains present after switch. Not tested on native — likely fine there because Expo Router remounts the tabs on state change. iter_11 already validated full 4-language render on reload.

integration_issues.flow: Family delete group via UI trash icon
integration_issues.issue: Clicking the trash icon (top-right of /more/group-detail) did not open the Alert.alert confirm dialog on web preview → group not deleted via UI. Cleanup succeeded via Supabase REST API. On native, Alert.alert should work — flag as web-preview limitation only if reproducible on device.

issues: Annual card badge '⭐ MEILLEURE OFFRE · -32%' overlaps the top of the annual card body on 390px viewport — minor overlap not blocking readability.
v3.8.0 polish (borderTopLeftRadius/Right = xl, premium shadow *1.1, height=70+insets) rendered correctly — no chevauchement clavier detected on inputs open (Expenses/Debts forms tested).

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warning on many screens. Non-blocking on native, but should be migrated for RN 0.76+/web parity.
'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' — web preview only, harmless on iOS/Android builds.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — legacy touchable somewhere; non-blocking.

action_items: CRITICAL — Fix appVersion in /app/frontend/app/more/settings.tsx:38: replace `const appVersion = '3.7.0';` with `const appVersion = Constants.expoConfig?.version ?? '3.8.0';` (Constants is already imported at line 26). Otherwise Settings screen shows 3.7.0 to end-users while the binary is 3.8.0/70 — Apple reviewer will notice.
MEDIUM — Add testID='add-expense-fab' (or similar) on the Expenses list add button so future E2E cloud-sync writes can be exercised via UI.
MEDIUM — Create /app/frontend/app/more/legal/support.tsx (or map the Support link elsewhere) — /more/legal/support currently 404s.
LOW — Rename 'Lancer l'analyse IA' CTA to 'Analyser' or update spec to match — pure copy alignment.
LOW — Investigate why (tabs)/_layout.tsx bottom-bar labels do not re-render on live language change (works after full reload); may just be a memoization issue on web, negligible on native.
LOW — Optional QoL from iter_10: apply ON DELETE CASCADE to group_invites.group_id FK in Supabase.
LOW — Migrate remaining shadow* / pointerEvents / useNativeDriver-warning-generating styles for cleaner RN 0.76+/web console.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx:38 — hard-coded version string is the #1 blocker. `expo-constants` is already imported; single-line fix.
(tabs)/_layout.tsx — polish (borderTopLeftRadius, shadow, elevation, haptic on tabPress via Haptics.selectionAsync()) is correctly gated by Platform.OS !== 'web' and .catch(()=>{}) — no crash risk.
family.tsx create-group modal uses input placeholder 'Famille Dupont, Coloc, Voyage Italie…' — clean UX; 8 emoji picker options render OK.
quick-add.tsx correctly parses both source=siri and source=text query params — amounts 25 & 95 CHF extracted, category inferred.
paywall.tsx exposes 'Restaurer' (top-right) + Annuel CHF 39.90/an + Mensuel CHF 4.90/mois + '7-day free trial' — App Store IAP-ready wording, no external payment provider mentioned.

email-import.tsx renders distinct titles for mode=invoice ('Importer une facture') vs mode=contract ('Importer un contrat') and shares body 'Importer un document en 1 tap' + 4 sources (Scanner, PDF, Fichiers, Galerie) + Astuces block.

success_rate.backend: n/a (no backend endpoints changed since iter_11)

seed_data_creation: Created group AUDIT-12-G (id=g_1783275846983) under e2e-test@budgy.ch during test. Cleaned up via Supabase REST DELETE (invites → group_expenses → expense_groups). No residual data. AUDIT-12 transaction was NOT created (add-expense FAB not found on UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Version display bug is a one-line fix in settings.tsx:38 — after main agent applies `const appVersion = Constants.expoConfig?.version ?? '3.8.0';`, re-run only Settings screen render check: `expect(page.locator('text=Version 3.8.0')).toBeVisible()`. All other domains passed. Note that on web preview, Alert.alert confirm dialogs (used for delete group) don't reliably open — this is a known RN-Web limitation, not a real bug. For E2E delete-group testing, use Supabase REST API directly (see /tmp/cleanup2.py pattern).
rca_of_issue: settings.tsx:38 was authored before the v3.7.0→v3.8.0 bump and never wired to Constants.expoConfig.version. When app.json was bumped to 3.8.0/70, this hard-coded const was overlooked. Reproduction: 1) Login as any user 2) Navigate /more/settings 3) Observe 'Version 3.7.0 · App Store Ready' in the Data section. Mitigation: replace with expo-constants-driven read (single import already present).

backend_side_findings.openai_api_key_invalid: Backend /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log shows repeated 'AuthenticationError: OpenAIException — Incorrect API key provided: sk-emerg…d346' on every POST /api/voice/parse. Voice parser correctly falls back to regex (200 OK still returned), and spec explicitly allows local fallback for ai-optimizer, so NOT blocking. But this means OpenAI-powered Budgy AI (LLM route) is currently non-functional in prod-preview. Action: rotate OPENAI_API_KEY in backend/.env before enabling any AI feature that strictly requires GPT.
backend_side_findings.backend_startup_version: Backend /startup log prints 'Budgy API v3.7.27' — this is the API-side semver (independent of mobile bundle 3.8.0/70). Not a compliance issue but flagging for coherence.

verdict: FIX_NEEDED — 1 blocking bug (settings version string), 3 medium (missing testID on add-expense FAB, missing /more/legal/support route, i18n web tab-bar refresh) + 4 low. Once settings.tsx:38 is patched, GO BUILD 70 PRODUCTION.
